title: Solution Architecture Review Process for Validated Systems
summary: Defines the architecture review and approval process within a QMS-governed SDLC. Covers five architecture domains, the Technical Design Authority (TDA) review board, and the Architecture Review Board (ARB) escalation path for non-standard technology choices.

findings.purpose_and_scope: Ensures product architecture is reviewed and approved before development begins. Aligned to ISO 9001:2015. Covers five architecture domains that must be evaluated for each product initiative.
findings.five_architecture_domains: Business Architecture (portfolio, processes, personas), Application Architecture (software, services), Data Architecture (data, information models), Integration Architecture (shared services, APIs), and Technical Architecture (infrastructure, network) plus DevOps considerations.
findings.key_roles: Product Owner provides concept, boost, and proof-of-concept documents as inputs. Application Engineering reviews application-level design. Integration Architecture evaluates integration patterns. Technical Architecture assesses infrastructure. The Technical Design Authority (TDA) Board is a virtual authority of subject matter experts that approves designs against standards.
findings.tda_review_process: Architecture inputs (Concept Document, Boost Document, POC Document) are reviewed against established standards. A TDA submission is prepared and evaluated. If the proposed design uses only approved technologies, TDA can approve directly. If new or non-approved technology is proposed, escalation to the Architecture Review Board is required before TDA approval.
findings.architecture_review_board: The ARB approves technology standards and defines IT strategies for the organization. It serves as the escalation authority when proposed solutions require technologies outside the approved catalog. ARB approval is a prerequisite for TDA sign-off when non-standard technology is involved.
findings.key_outputs: TDA Submission document (retained for life of system plus 10 years, stored in TDA repository) and ARB Document when applicable (same retention period, stored in ARB repository).
findings.kpis: Average TDA approval lead time with a target of 5 or fewer business days. Percentage of TDA submissions approved at first attempt with a target of 80% or higher.
findings.cross_references: Follows Product Release Scope Definition SOP for upstream inputs. Feeds into Product Release Development SOP for downstream execution.

source: SOP-0018[3] Solution Architecture, ISO 9001:2015, effective Nov 2021
